global_conclusion: Frozen 3-seed Transformer averaging consistently improves ADE and FDE relative to mean individual-seed error on BIRDSAI TestReal and fresh WildBox for both 2s and 5s horizons.
recommended_pipeline_role: Use the frozen 3-seed Transformer prediction ensemble as the primary Transformer output for downstream uncertainty and warning analysis.
claim_guardrails: Do not generalize ensemble benefit to GRU/LSTM without separate evidence.
Do not call the 3-video WildBox holdout broad ecological generalization.
Do not treat diversity-gain correlation as causal evidence.
Do not claim end-to-end field effectiveness from forecasting ensemble results alone.
